newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Jan 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Jan 8.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- United Arab Emirates sets up shareholding firm for satellite project with $25 million starting capital.
- United Arab Emirates' oil production expected to hit three million barrels per day in the year 2000.
- Saudi investors offer to participate in industrial and tourism projects worth $600 million in Egypt.
- Syria plans to build two oil refineries, hold talks with Chinese and Romanian companies.
- Hundreds of Kuwaiti debtors rush to banks to repay their debts.
